technical_issues.where: Project Plan & Preliminary Progress — Orbit Specifics
technical_issues.issue: States geostationary orbit at 600 km altitude; GEO is ~35,786 km, 600 km is LEO and cannot remain fixed over the reef.
Claims 2016 bleaching killed 60% and 2017 another 50% of GBR coral; actual mortality estimates are substantially lower (~20–30% per event).
'Oceans have become 30 percent more acidic' is imprecise; pH has dropped ~0.1, representing ~30% increase in hydrogen ion concentration.
No quantitative mission requirements (spatial resolution, revisit time, spectral bands, data latency) are specified.
Gantt chart shows background research as both completed (gold) and ongoing (blue) in overlapping weeks; editing scheduled weeks 9–10 but text says weeks 7–8 reserved for review.

overall: A clear, well-structured preliminary report with a strong mission rationale and detailed Gantt plan. However, it contains a major orbit error (GEO at 600 km), exaggerated bleaching statistics, lacks quantitative mission requirements, contingency planning, and a proper reference list. Preliminary technical results are minimal.

feedback.summary: You present a clear, well-structured report with a strong mission rationale, identified users and a detailed Gantt plan. Key improvements: correct the orbit error (GEO at 600 km is LEO; GEO is ~35,786 km), replace exaggerated bleaching/acidification statistics with cited figures, add quantitative mission requirements, include contingency planning and a proper reference list, and present preliminary technical results with interpretation.
next_steps: Correct the orbit statement in 'Project Plan & Preliminary Progress — Orbit Specifics': 600 km is LEO, not GEO (~35,786 km). Justify your orbit choice against revisit time and spatial resolution needs.

Add a quantitative requirements table in 'Mission Concept & Rationale' (spatial resolution, revisit time, spectral bands, data latency) and replace the 60%/50% bleaching and '30% more acidic' claims with accurate, cited figures.

Strengthen 'Project Plan & Preliminary Progress': add explicit contingency provisions and a dedicated information-sources list, fix Gantt inconsistencies (background research overlap; editing weeks 9–10 vs review weeks 7–8), and include preliminary STK simulation outputs with brief interpretation. Format references as proper citations, not URL-only.

criteria.C1: You clearly identify users and the mission need, with a good rationale and references. To reach Accomplished, add quantitative mission requirements (resolution, revisit, spectral bands, latency) and correct the bleaching (60%/50%) and acidification claims with accurate, cited figures.
criteria.C2: Your Gantt chart and task descriptions demonstrate feasibility. For Accomplished, include explicit contingency provisions and a dedicated list of planned information sources, and align the Gantt with the text (background research overlap; editing weeks 9–10 vs review weeks 7–8).
criteria.C3: You completed STK tutorials 1–4 and background research, but no technical results are presented. To reach Accomplished, include preliminary simulation outputs (e.g., orbit/coverage) with brief interpretation, and correct the GEO altitude error (600 km is LEO; GEO ~35,786 km).
criteria.C4: Your report is well-structured and readable, with clear headings and a labelled Gantt chart. For Accomplished, format references as proper citations (not URL-only), ensure in-text citations match the reference list, and tighten informal phrasing.
